description: Seven builder stories: GPT-6 Astra agentic launch and its Critical cyber rating, Shanghai's 744B open-weight Atria Dawn, Anthropic's merged Cowork with Docs and Slides, Perplexity's on-device Windows agent, LM-Kit One private server, and Stanford's Paper2Agent.
lead: Frontier agents, open weights, and private local AI lead the last 24 hours. OpenAI shipped an agentic flagship that immediately drew a first-ever Critical cyber rating, Shanghai AI Lab quietly dropped a 744B MIT-licensed agentic model, and Anthropic merged Cowork into Claude with its own Docs and Slides. Perplexity and LM-Kit push agents that run on hardware you control, and Stanford turns papers into runnable MCP servers. Every summary is in our own words; follow the links for the original reporting.
title: AI news digest — September 17, 2026: frontier agents, open weights, and private local AI
